company_profile: Sportradar is a sports technology company whose Quants team builds pre-match and in-play predictive models for betting operators, media and sports federations.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years building predictive models across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Focuses on time-series forecasting and predictive modelling with LSTM, XGBoost, LightGBM, Holt-Winters and regression, from cleaning and analysing data in Python and SQL to evaluating and improving models in production. Works closely with stakeholders and engineering teams. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

experience_edits.original: Shipped anomaly detection and demand forecasting on 15+ KPIs
experience_edits.new: Shipped demand forecasting with Holt-Winters and anomaly detection with Isolation Forest on 15+ KPIs across 500+ telecom network devices, enabling earlier detection and proactive network planning.

experience_edits.original: Developed an XGBoost propensity model predicting personal-loan applications
experience_edits.new: Developed an XGBoost propensity model predicting the probability of a personal-loan application within 7 days of contact, enabling targeted outreach and customer prioritization.

experience_edits.original: Wrote complex SQL queries with multi-table joins
experience_edits.new: Wrote complex SQL queries with multi-table joins, CTEs and window functions to analyze data, delivering ad-hoc reports and analyses for multiple stakeholder teams.

project.name: Match Outcome Probability Models
bullets: Built pre-match and in-play probability models for football outcomes, combining a Poisson GLM with Bayesian team-strength priors and time-series features of recent form.
Evaluated calibration and log loss on held-out seasons against market odds, and packaged the models as a tested library with documented versions for downstream pricing.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist role in the Quants team. Most of my career has been predictive modelling on messy real-world data, with a strong focus on time-series forecasting in telecom. I enjoy the whole cycle: cleaning the data, building the model, and then checking honestly whether it holds up.

Sports betting markets are one of the clearest tests of a predictive model, because every price is checked against what actually happens. That appeals to me a lot. On the personal side, my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Austria together and settle there long term.

I would bring forecasting experience that has run in production. I built LSTM and XGBoost models forecasting call and SMS handover volumes for base stations, developed a univariate KPI forecasting feature for an AIOps monitoring product, and ran Holt-Winters demand forecasting across 500+ network devices.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to build for the people who rely on the result, not for the demo. I would welcome the chance to talk with your team.
